name: What is the typical timeframe for cabinet installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeframe for cabinet installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe for cabinet installation varies based on the project's scope, including the number of cabinets, the complexity of the design, and any necessary site preparation. A standard kitchen cabinet installation typically takes 3-5 days. Custom or larger projects may require more time. We will provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific needs during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard kitchen cabinet installation usually takes 3-5 days, but can vary based on project complexity.
